test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What was the key defense procurement, approved in September 2024, to enhance India’s naval defense capabilities?

options.text: Approval of seven Project 17B stealth frigates for the Indian Navy
Acquisition of advanced naval radar systems
Launch of a new aircraft carrier for the Indian Navy

solution:
The correct answer is __**Approval of seven Project 17B stealth frigates for the Indian Navy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Project 17B** is a class of **stealth frigates** being constructed for the **Indian Navy**.
 
• These frigates are equipped with advanced **stealth features** that minimize their detection by enemy radar and sonar.
 
• They come with enhanced **combat capabilities** and are designed to carry out a variety of missions including anti-surface, anti-submarine, and anti-air operations.
 
• The approval of these **seven Project 17B frigates** significantly boosts India's naval defense capabilities.
 
• This project involves the use of advanced **technologies** and **indigenous resources**, contributing to India's **self-reliance** in defense production.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Advanced naval radar systems**__

 __
 
• These systems are crucial for **surveillance** and **target detection** in maritime operations.
 
• They provide the navy with the ability to detect and track both surface and aerial threats.
 
 
 
• **Aircraft carriers**__
 __
 
• Aircraft carriers serve as a **floating airbase** and are pivotal in power projection and force multiplication in naval warfare.
 
• India already has **INS Vikramaditya** and the indigenous **INS Vikrant** in its fleet.
 
 
 
• **Multi-role submarines**__
 
 
• These submarines are capable of performing a variety of roles including **surveillance**, **reconnaissance**, and **combat operations**.
 
• They are equipped with advanced **sonar systems** and **torpedoes**.
